name: Affliction Consolation Under
overview: Scripture reveals that God provides enduring consolation amid affliction, as the eternal God is described as a refuge with everlasting arms supporting His people (Deuteronomy 33:27). Even in the darkest trials, such as walking through the valley of the shadow of death, believers find comfort in God's presence and guidance (Psalms 23:4). The promise of resurrection and seeing God beyond physical suffering offers profound hope (Job 19:25-26), while God's faithfulness to the forsaken, including those deserted by parents or friends, assures that He will gather and uphold them (Psalms 27:10). Furthermore, God is attentive to the needs of the poor and fatherless, actively helping those who commit themselves to Him (Psalms 10:14).
